description: List people in a course with names, roles and user IDs, optionally filtered by role or name. Read-only. Your school's privacy settings often limit or block this for students.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).
